name: Rocket Fuel - (5g) Baller Bucket - OG Kush
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Rocket Fuel OG Kush Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

OG Kush is a true cornerstone strain and one of the most recognizable names in cannabis. Expect its unmistakable profile: pungent fuel and earthy pine up front, layered with lemon-citrus brightness and a spicy, woody finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a potent, well-balanced experience that lifts the head while settling the body into a heavy, easygoing calm.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature OG Kush flavor — pungent fuel and earthy pine with lemon and spice
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel OG Kush is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
